Items.text: You reach out and touch Bubba's shoulder...
[PLACEHOLDER: Bubba's dream, Platinum Prep in an earthquake, and his fight. This plays as text until the dream scene and the fight are built.]

Items.name: Bubba
Items.text: This is it. Platinum Prep. Mom and Dad are gonna be so proud of me.
The ground shakes. Cracks race up the marble columns.

Items.name: Bubba
Items.text: No... no, no, no! Not now!

Items.name: Bubba
Items.text: You?! What are you doing here? Get out of my dream!
[FIGHT: Bubba. A real fight; if you lose, you try again.]

Items.name: Bubba
Items.text: I worked so hard for this...
The last of Platinum Prep crumbles away, and the dream breaks apart beneath you.
